verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents backups of an entire instance or selected collections to S3, GCS or Azure, including restore across storage providers. Because it is open source and self-hostable via Docker or Kubernetes, a user can move data out of Weaviate Cloud. The evidence never says the backups are in an open or portable format, nor that data can be exported for use outside Weaviate. Missing for 10: documented export to open formats (e.g. JSON/Parquet/CSV with vectors), evidence that the backup format is readable outside Weaviate, a migration/exit guide, independent hands-on corroboration of a full data export.
